integrity: The mathematical proof, evidence and numerical limitations are supplied in the present package; no independent historical or mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Successive large-radius and then large-deficit limits; dimensional parameter fixed. The two-dimensional approximate distance law and qualitative threshold were already known; proposed value concerns exact higher-dimensional limiting constants and odd-dimensional phase-type factorization. Numerical checks are not proofs, and absolute historical priority remains provisional.
title: Three-regime radial–angular distance-deficit laws in expanding hyperbolic balls
